Có now, right now, at the moment → thì hiện tại tiếp diễn: am/is/are + V-ing.

scenes.question: Tom is my friend. I often play football with ___.
scenes.hint:
Sau giới từ with dùng tân ngữ: him.

👉 Tom is my friend. I often play football with him.

scenes.question:

scenes.hint:

scenes.question: We often go ___ the wax museum.
scenes.hint:
go to + nơi chốn: đi đến …

scenes.question: He often ___ to the mall.

scenes.question:

I was <u>at the zoo</u>.

✅ D. Where were you last weekend?
👉 Phần gạch chân 'at the zoo' → hỏi nơi chốn (Where).

scenes.question: Choose the correct question.

scenes.hint:

scenes.question: Find the word with a different sound in the underlined part.
scenes.hint:

scenes.question: How many syllables are there in the word "answer"?
scenes.hint:

scenes.question: Choose the odd one out.
scenes.hint:

scenes.question: How do you say this date: "21st April"?

scenes.question: The dry season is from December ___ April.

from … to …: từ … đến …

scenes.question: Find the word with a different sound in the underlined part.

👉 Đuôi -ed trong walked đọc /t/; trong painted, added, planted đọc /ɪd/.

scenes.question: Choose the correct sentence.

scenes.question: How many syllables are there in the word "buying"?
scenes.hint:

✅ B. two → 2 âm tiết (buying)

scenes.question: Choose the correct question.

scenes.question: Ben finishes his homework ___.

scenes.question: I have ___ hat.

scenes.question: Which word has the same sound as the underlined part of 'ni<u>c</u>e'?
scenes.hint:

scenes.question: Choose the odd one out.

scenes.question: Choose the sentence with the adverb in the correct position.

scenes.hint:

scenes.question: They usually ___ a horse.

scenes.question: Choose the sentence with the adverb in the correct position.

Trạng từ chỉ tần suất (always, usually, often, never…) đứng TRƯỚC động từ thường và SAU động từ to be (am/is/are).

scenes.question: What is your father like?

scenes.question: Trang ___ to music at the moment.

scenes.question: Choose the sentence with the adverb in the correct position.

B. I go always to the playground.
C. I go to the playground always.

Lucy gets up at a quarter past six every morning. She brushes her teeth and has breakfast. Then she goes to school by bus at seven o'clock. After school, she plays football. She has dinner with her family at seven o'clock and goes to bed at nine o'clock.

Lucy goes to school by bus.
scenes.hint:
✅ A. True
📖 Bài đọc: Then she goes to school by bus at seven o'clock.

scenes.question:
Is this sentence correct? Choose True or False.
My friends cleans the floor on Saturdays.
scenes.hint:
✅ B. False
👉 Sửa: My friends clean the floor on Saturdays. (chủ ngữ 'My friends' → động từ nguyên thể 'clean')
→ Các bạn của mình lau nhà vào các ngày thứ Bảy.

scenes.question:
Read and choose True or False.
Last week, Rosy and her family went to Sa Pa. They went there by train. They stayed there for three days. They climbed mountains and visited a village. They also ate grilled corn. Rosy bought some T-shirts for her friends. It was a wonderful trip!

Rosy bought some T-shirts for her friends.
scenes.hint:
✅ A. True
📖 Bài đọc: Rosy bought some T-shirts for her friends.

scenes.question:
Read and choose True or False.
Hi, I'm Peter. I'm ten years old and I'm in Class 4B. I live in Quang Ninh with my family. My favourite subject is IT because I like using computers. I'm good at playing chess. At the weekend, I usually read comics. I want to be a pilot in the future because I want to fly around the world.

Peter wants to be a singer in the future.
scenes.hint:
✅ B. False
📖 Bài đọc: I want to be a pilot in the future because I want to fly around the world.
👉 Đáp án đúng: a pilot

scenes.question: Amy is from Korea. She is Korean.
scenes.hint:
✅ A. True
Amy is from Korea. She is Korean. → Amy đến từ Hàn Quốc. Cô ấy là người Hàn Quốc.

scenes.question: Nine times four is thirty-six.
scenes.hint:
✅ A. True
Nine times four is thirty-six. → 9 × 4 = 36.

scenes.question:
Read and choose True or False.
Last summer, Nam and his family went to Ha Long Bay. They went there by plane. They stayed there for three days. They went on a boat trip and visited some caves. They also ate seafood. Nam bought some sweets for his friends. It was a wonderful trip!

Nam went to Hoi An.
scenes.hint:
✅ B. False
📖 Bài đọc: Last summer, Nam and his family went to Ha Long Bay.
👉 Đáp án đúng: Ha Long Bay

scenes.question: Sue is from Malaysia. She is English.
scenes.hint:
✅ B. False
Sue is from Malaysia. She is English. → Sue đến từ Ma-lai-xi-a. Cô ấy là người Anh.
👉 Malaysia → Malaysian (người Ma-lai-xi-a)

scenes.question:
Read and choose True or False.
Tim gets up at a quarter to six every morning. He brushes his teeth and has breakfast. Then he goes to school by motorbike with his father at a quarter past seven. After school, he does homework. He has dinner with his family at seven o'clock and goes to bed at nine o'clock.

Tim goes to school by motorbike.
scenes.hint:
✅ A. True
📖 Bài đọc: Then he goes to school by motorbike with his father at a quarter past seven.

scenes.question: A lesson starts at 8:30 and lasts sixty minutes, so it finishes at 10:00.
scenes.hint:
✅ B. False
A lesson starts at 8:30 and lasts sixty minutes, so it finishes at 10:00. → Tiết học bắt đầu lúc 8:30, kéo dài 60 phút, kết thúc lúc 10:00.
👉 8:30 + 60 phút = 9:30

scenes.question: Do you rarely go ___ school by bus?
scenes.hint:
go to + nơi chốn: đi đến …
✅ C. to
👉 Do you rarely go to school by bus?

scenes.question: Choose the odd one out.
scenes.hint:
✅ A. black
👉 'black' thuộc nhóm màu sắc; các từ còn lại (kind, shy, lazy) thuộc nhóm tính từ chỉ tính cách.

scenes.question: What does your brother like?
choices: B. He is a police officer.
D. He is cheerful and generous.
scenes.hint:
What does … like? hỏi về sở thích → trả lời bằng likes + danh từ/V-ing.
✅ A. He likes dancing.

scenes.question:
Choose the correct question for the underlined part.
It's <u>next to the kitchen</u>.
scenes.hint:
Đặt câu hỏi cho phần gạch chân.
✅ C. Where's the study?
👉 Phần gạch chân 'next to the kitchen' → hỏi nơi chốn (Where).

scenes.question: This restaurant is ___ than that restaurant.
scenes.hint:
Tính từ ngắn: adj + -er + than; tính từ dài: more + adj + than; bất quy tắc: good → better, bad → worse. Không dùng 'more' với tính từ đã thêm -er.
✅ D. colder
👉 This restaurant is colder than that restaurant.

scenes.question: Which word has the underlined part pronounced /ɪd/?
scenes.hint:
Quy tắc -ed: đọc /ɪd/ sau âm /t/, /d/; đọc /t/ sau âm vô thanh (/p/, /k/, /f/, /s/, /ʃ/, /tʃ/); đọc /d/ sau các âm còn lại.
✅ B. visited
👉 Đuôi -ed trong visited đọc /ɪd/; trong brushed, washed, skipped đọc /t/.

scenes.question: Do you usually go ___ school by bus?
scenes.hint:
go to + nơi chốn: đi đến …
✅ D. to
👉 Do you usually go to school by bus?

scenes.question: Find the word with a different sound in the underlined part.
scenes.hint:
Quy tắc -s/-es: đọc /ɪz/ sau âm /s/, /z/, /ʃ/, /ʒ/, /tʃ/, /dʒ/; đọc /s/ sau âm vô thanh (/p/, /k/, /f/, /t/, /θ/); đọc /z/ sau các âm còn lại.
✅ B. stones
👉 Đuôi -s/-es trong stones đọc /z/; trong finishes, teaches, houses đọc /ɪz/.

scenes.question: This is the ___ city in the country.
scenes.hint:
Tính từ ngắn: the + adj + -est; tính từ dài: the most + adj; bất quy tắc: good → best, bad → worst. Không dùng 'most' với tính từ đã thêm -est.
✅ B. most wonderful
👉 This is the most wonderful city in the country.

scenes.question: Which word has the underlined part pronounced /s/?
scenes.hint:
Quy tắc -s/-es: đọc /ɪz/ sau âm /s/, /z/, /ʃ/, /ʒ/, /tʃ/, /dʒ/; đọc /s/ sau âm vô thanh (/p/, /k/, /f/, /t/, /θ/); đọc /z/ sau các âm còn lại.
✅ A. necks
👉 Đuôi -s/-es trong necks đọc /s/; trong fridges, watches, places đọc /ɪz/.

scenes.question: He wants ___ fridge.
scenes.hint:
Dùng 'an' trước từ bắt đầu bằng nguyên âm (a, e, i, o, u); dùng 'a' trước phụ âm. fridge bắt đầu bằng âm phụ âm → a fridge.
✅ C. a

scenes.question:
Choose the correct question for the underlined part.
It's <u>under the table</u>.
scenes.hint:
Đặt câu hỏi cho phần gạch chân.
✅ B. Where is the cat?
👉 Phần gạch chân 'under the table' → hỏi nơi chốn (Where).

scenes.question: He ___ volleyball at the moment.
scenes.hint:
Có now, right now, at the moment → thì hiện tại tiếp diễn: am/is/are + V-ing.
✅ B. is playing
👉 He is playing volleyball at the moment.

scenes.question: Find the word with a different sound in the underlined part.
scenes.hint:
Quy tắc -ed: đọc /ɪd/ sau âm /t/, /d/; đọc /t/ sau âm vô thanh (/p/, /k/, /f/, /s/, /ʃ/, /tʃ/); đọc /d/ sau các âm còn lại.
✅ B. planted
👉 Đuôi -ed trong planted đọc /ɪd/; trong laughed, cooked, fixed đọc /t/.

scenes.question: What does Khang do?
choices: A. He is a police officer.
B. He is cheerful and clever.
D. He has curly hair and blue eyes.
scenes.hint:
What does … do? hỏi về nghề nghiệp → trả lời bằng is a + nghề nghiệp.
✅ A. He is a police officer.

scenes.question:
Choose the correct question for the underlined part.
We have dinner <u>at six o</u>'<u>clock</u> in the evening.
choices: A. How often do you have dinner?
B. Where do you have dinner?
C. How do you have dinner?

scenes.hint:
Đặt câu hỏi cho phần gạch chân.
✅ D. What time do you have dinner?
👉 Phần gạch chân 'at six o'clock' → hỏi giờ (What time).

scenes.question: Which word has a different stress pattern from the others?
scenes.hint:
✅ B. machine
👉 machine nhấn trọng âm ở âm tiết thứ 2; kitten, rainy, armchair nhấn ở âm tiết thứ 1.

scenes.question: We don't go ___ school.
scenes.hint:
go to + nơi chốn: đi đến …
✅ D. to
👉 We don't go to school.

scenes.question: Vy, Phong, and Duy go ___ the same school.
scenes.hint:
go to + nơi chốn: đi đến …
✅ C. to
👉 Vy, Phong, and Duy go to the same school.

scenes.question: Choose the odd one out.
scenes.hint:
✅ B. eagle
👉 'eagle' thuộc nhóm động vật; các từ còn lại (head, arm, finger) thuộc nhóm bộ phận cơ thể.

scenes.question: Choose the odd one out.
scenes.hint:
✅ C. bus → xe buýt
👉 'bus' thuộc nhóm phương tiện giao thông; các từ còn lại (onion, broccoli, tomato) thuộc nhóm rau củ.

scenes.question: My grandmother ___ the dog last Sunday.
scenes.hint:
Có dấu hiệu quá khứ (yesterday, last…, …ago) → thì quá khứ đơn: động từ thêm -ed hoặc dùng dạng bất quy tắc.
✅ C. walked
👉 My grandmother walked the dog last Sunday.

scenes.question: What does your brother look like?
choices: A. He is tall and slim.
C. He is friendly and honest.
D. He is a police officer.
scenes.hint:
What does … look like? hỏi về ngoại hình → trả lời về chiều cao, vóc dáng, tóc, mắt…

scenes.question: Find the word with a different sound in the underlined part.
scenes.hint:
✅ C. front
👉 'o' trong front đọc /ʌ/; trong home, sold, wrote đọc /əʊ/.

scenes.question: Find the word with a different sound in the underlined part.
scenes.hint:
✅ D. stage
👉 'g' trong stage đọc /dʒ/; trong girl, get, glasses đọc /g/.

scenes.question: Which sentence is NOT correct?
choices: A. Hoa drank milk yesterday morning.
B. He usually does his homework after school.
C. He always goes to school by bus.
D. Phong and Nga is washing the dishes right now.
scenes.hint:
Có now, right now, at the moment → thì hiện tại tiếp diễn: am/is/are + V-ing.
✅ D. Phong and Nga is washing the dishes right now.
👉 Câu đúng: Phong and Nga are washing the dishes right now.

scenes.question: What does Hoa do?
choices: B. She is brave and kind.
C. She has long straight hair.
scenes.hint:
What does … do? hỏi về nghề nghiệp → trả lời bằng is a + nghề nghiệp.

scenes.question:
Choose the correct question for the underlined part.
It's <u>next to the TV</u>.
choices: A. Why is my toy boat?
B. How is my toy boat?
C. Where is my toy boat?
D. What time is my toy boat?
scenes.hint:
Đặt câu hỏi cho phần gạch chân.
✅ C. Where is my toy boat?
👉 Phần gạch chân 'next to the TV' → hỏi nơi chốn (Where).

scenes.question: Which word has a different stress pattern from the others?
scenes.hint:
✅ B. hotel
👉 hotel nhấn trọng âm ở âm tiết thứ 2; stronger, future, attic nhấn ở âm tiết thứ 1.

scenes.question: Which sentence is NOT correct?
choices: A. Max and Mia are playing badminton now.
B. He always reads in the library.
C. We learned English next Sunday.
scenes.hint:
Có tomorrow, next… → thì tương lai đơn: will + V nguyên thể.

👉 Câu đúng: We will learn English next Sunday.

scenes.question: Choose the correct sentence.
choices: A. Sam is buying some bread right now.
B. Sam are buying some bread right now.
C. Sam buys some bread right now.
D. Sam bought some bread right now.
scenes.hint:
Có now, right now, at the moment → thì hiện tại tiếp diễn: am/is/are + V-ing.
✅ A. Sam is buying some bread right now.

scenes.question: They listen ___ music.
scenes.hint:
listen to + (music/someone): nghe …
✅ A. to
👉 They listen to music.

scenes.question:
Choose the correct question for the underlined part.
It's <u>next to the kitchen</u>.
scenes.hint:
Đặt câu hỏi cho phần gạch chân.
✅ D. Where's the hall?
👉 Phần gạch chân 'next to the kitchen' → hỏi nơi chốn (Where).

scenes.question: Which month comes after July?
scenes.hint:
Thứ tự các tháng: January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November, December.
✅ B. August

scenes.question: Which word has the underlined part pronounced /t/?
scenes.hint:
Quy tắc -ed: đọc /ɪd/ sau âm /t/, /d/; đọc /t/ sau âm vô thanh (/p/, /k/, /f/, /s/, /ʃ/, /tʃ/); đọc /d/ sau các âm còn lại.
✅ D. terraced
👉 Đuôi -ed trong terraced đọc /t/; trong opened, arrived, travelled đọc /d/.

scenes.question: Find the word with a different sound in the underlined part.
scenes.hint:
Quy tắc -ed: đọc /ɪd/ sau âm /t/, /d/; đọc /t/ sau âm vô thanh (/p/, /k/, /f/, /s/, /ʃ/, /tʃ/); đọc /d/ sau các âm còn lại.
✅ D. followed
👉 Đuôi -ed trong followed đọc /d/; trong skipped, helped, walked đọc /t/.

scenes.question: How many syllables are there in the word "inside"?
scenes.hint:
Đếm số âm tiết (mỗi âm tiết có đúng một nguyên âm được đọc lên).
✅ B. two → 2 âm tiết (inside)
👉 Tách âm tiết: in-side

scenes.question:
Choose the correct question for the underlined part.
I go home <u>at </u>4 p.m. every day.
choices: A. What time do you go home?
B. How often do you go home?
C. Why do you go home?
D. Where do you go home?
scenes.hint:
Đặt câu hỏi cho phần gạch chân.
✅ A. What time do you go home?
👉 Phần gạch chân 'at 4' → hỏi giờ (What time).

scenes.question: I study geography ___ Mondays.
scenes.hint:
on + thứ trong tuần (on Mondays, on Sunday).
✅ C. on
👉 I study geography on Mondays.

scenes.question: How many syllables are there in the word "classroom"?
scenes.hint:
Đếm số âm tiết (mỗi âm tiết có đúng một nguyên âm được đọc lên).
✅ B. two → 2 âm tiết (classroom → lớp học)
👉 Tách âm tiết: class-room

scenes.question: Which word has the same sound as the underlined part of 'mo<u>th</u>er'?
scenes.hint:
✅ C. other
👉 'th' trong mother và other đều đọc /ð/; trong something, theatre, thousand đọc /θ/.

scenes.question: Kate ___ rope next Sunday.
scenes.hint:
Có tomorrow, next… → thì tương lai đơn: will + V nguyên thể.
✅ C. will skip

scenes.question: Choose the sentence with the adverb in the correct position.
choices: A. I walk always to school.
B. Always I walk to school.
C. I walk to school always.
D. I always walk to school.
scenes.hint:
Trạng từ chỉ tần suất (always, usually, often, never…) đứng TRƯỚC động từ thường và SAU động từ to be (am/is/are).
✅ D. I always walk to school.

scenes.question: Ben ___ swimming last night.
scenes.hint:
Có dấu hiệu quá khứ (yesterday, last…, …ago) → thì quá khứ đơn: động từ thêm -ed hoặc dùng dạng bất quy tắc.

👉 Ben went swimming last night.

scenes.question:
Choose the correct question for the underlined part.
I eat dinner <u>at </u>6:00.
choices: A. Where do you eat dinner?

scenes.question: I sometimes ___ lunch at school.

scenes.question: Jack is ___ than Lily.

scenes.question: Lan is ___ than Peter.

✅ B. faster
👉 Lan is faster than Peter.

scenes.question: Which word has a different stress pattern from the others?
scenes.hint:
✅ C. forty
👉 forty nhấn trọng âm ở âm tiết thứ 1; forget, today, alone nhấn ở âm tiết thứ 2.

scenes.question: He usually goes ___ school by bus.

go to + nơi chốn: đi đến …

scenes.hint:

scenes.question: When were you born?

B. I was born in Hai Phong.
D. I live in Da Nang.
scenes.hint:
When were you born? hỏi thời gian sinh → I was born in + năm/tháng; on + ngày.

scenes.question: Which sentence is NOT correct?

scenes.question: Choose the correct sentence.

scenes.question: Find the word with a different sound in the underlined part.

Quy tắc -s/-es: đọc /ɪz/ sau âm /s/, /z/, /ʃ/, /ʒ/, /tʃ/, /dʒ/; đọc /s/ sau âm vô thanh (/p/, /k/, /f/, /t/, /θ/); đọc /z/ sau các âm còn lại.

Quy tắc -s/-es: đọc /ɪz/ sau âm /s/, /z/, /ʃ/, /ʒ/, /tʃ/, /dʒ/; đọc /s/ sau âm vô thanh (/p/, /k/, /f/, /t/, /θ/); đọc /z/ sau các âm còn lại.

scenes.question: How many syllables are there in the word "world"?

scenes.hint:
Trạng từ chỉ tần suất (always, usually, often, never…) đứng TRƯỚC động từ thường và SAU động từ to be (am/is/are).
✅ D. My mother usually cooks special food during Tet.

scenes.question: Amy is ___ than Nam.
scenes.hint:
Tính từ ngắn: adj + -er + than; tính từ dài: more + adj + than; bất quy tắc: good → better, bad → worse. Không dùng 'more' với tính từ đã thêm -er.
✅ A. funnier
👉 Amy is funnier than Nam.

scenes.question: Find the word with a different sound in the underlined part.
scenes.hint:
Quy tắc -s/-es: đọc /ɪz/ sau âm /s/, /z/, /ʃ/, /ʒ/, /tʃ/, /dʒ/; đọc /s/ sau âm vô thanh (/p/, /k/, /f/, /t/, /θ/); đọc /z/ sau các âm còn lại.
✅ A. lasts
👉 Đuôi -s/-es trong lasts đọc /ɪz/; trong breaks, roofs, likes đọc /s/.

scenes.question: I often ___ to Times Square with my parents to welcome the New Year.
scenes.hint:
Có every…, always, usually, often, sometimes, never, on Mondays… → thì hiện tại đơn: chủ ngữ số ít (he/she/it/tên riêng) + V-s/es; I/you/we/they/số nhiều + V nguyên thể.
✅ C. go
👉 I often go to Times Square with my parents to welcome the New Year.

scenes.question: Choose the correct sentence.
choices: A. Mary plays the piano right now.
B. Mary are playing the piano right now.
C. Mary played the piano right now.
D. Mary is playing the piano right now.
scenes.hint:
Có now, right now, at the moment → thì hiện tại tiếp diễn: am/is/are + V-ing.
✅ D. Mary is playing the piano right now.

scenes.question: What is Nga like?
choices: A. She is funny and brave.
scenes.hint:
What is … like? hỏi về tính cách → trả lời bằng tính từ chỉ tính cách (kind, funny…).
✅ A. She is funny and brave.

scenes.question: Find the word with a different sound in the underlined part.
scenes.hint:
Quy tắc -ed: đọc /ɪd/ sau âm /t/, /d/; đọc /t/ sau âm vô thanh (/p/, /k/, /f/, /s/, /ʃ/, /tʃ/); đọc /d/ sau các âm còn lại.
✅ C. rented
👉 Đuôi -ed trong rented đọc /ɪd/; trong washed, asked, skipped đọc /t/.

scenes.question: Choose the correct sentence.
choices: A. I went to the zoo last night.
B. I am going to the zoo last night.
C. I go to the zoo last night.
D. I going to the zoo last night.
scenes.hint:
Có dấu hiệu quá khứ (yesterday, last…, …ago) → thì quá khứ đơn: động từ thêm -ed hoặc dùng dạng bất quy tắc.
✅ A. I went to the zoo last night.

scenes.question: They ___ a model plane last month.
scenes.hint:
Có dấu hiệu quá khứ (yesterday, last…, …ago) → thì quá khứ đơn: động từ thêm -ed hoặc dùng dạng bất quy tắc.
✅ A. made
👉 They made a model plane last month.

scenes.question: We ___ chess every Saturday.
scenes.hint:
Có every…, always, usually, often, sometimes, never, on Mondays… → thì hiện tại đơn: chủ ngữ số ít (he/she/it/tên riêng) + V-s/es; I/you/we/they/số nhiều + V nguyên thể.
✅ B. play
👉 We play chess every Saturday.

scenes.question: Find the word with a different sound in the underlined part.
scenes.hint:
Quy tắc -ed: đọc /ɪd/ sau âm /t/, /d/; đọc /t/ sau âm vô thanh (/p/, /k/, /f/, /s/, /ʃ/, /tʃ/); đọc /d/ sau các âm còn lại.
✅ B. used
👉 Đuôi -ed trong used đọc /d/; trong cooked, walked, practised đọc /t/.

scenes.question: When were you born?
choices: A. I was born in Can Tho.
C. I live in Ho Chi Minh City.
D. I was born on the seventh of January.
scenes.hint:
When were you born? hỏi thời gian sinh → I was born in + năm/tháng; on + ngày.
✅ D. I was born on the seventh of January.

scenes.question: Which word has the same sound as the underlined part of 'l<u>oo</u>k'?
scenes.hint:
✅ B. took
👉 'oo' trong look và took đều đọc /ʊ/; trong floors, door, floor đọc /ɔː/.

scenes.question: Choose the odd one out.
scenes.hint:
✅ B. shoes → giày
👉 'shoes' thuộc nhóm quần áo; các từ còn lại (coffee, cola, tea) thuộc nhóm đồ uống.

scenes.question: How many syllables are there in the word "evening"?
scenes.hint:
Đếm số âm tiết (mỗi âm tiết có đúng một nguyên âm được đọc lên).
✅ B. two → 2 âm tiết (evening)

scenes.question: Which sentence is NOT correct?
choices: A. We are going to school now.
B. Linh and Anna cook dinner yesterday.
C. Kate will get up tomorrow morning.
D. My friends will do morning exercise tomorrow.
scenes.hint:
Có dấu hiệu quá khứ (yesterday, last…, …ago) → thì quá khứ đơn: động từ thêm -ed hoặc dùng dạng bất quy tắc.
✅ B. Linh and Anna cook dinner yesterday.
👉 Câu đúng: Linh and Anna cooked dinner yesterday.

scenes.question:
Choose the correct question for the underlined part.
He works on a ship, and she works <u>in a restaurant</u>.
scenes.hint:
Đặt câu hỏi cho phần gạch chân.
✅ B. Where do they work?
👉 Phần gạch chân 'in a restaurant' → hỏi nơi chốn (Where).

scenes.question:
Choose the correct question for the underlined part.
At different times. This year, it's <u>in January</u>.
scenes.hint:
Đặt câu hỏi cho phần gạch chân.
✅ A. When is Tet?
👉 Phần gạch chân 'in January' → hỏi thời gian chung chung: ngày, tháng, năm, mùa… (When).

scenes.question: They won't go ___ the National Park.
scenes.hint:
go to + nơi chốn: đi đến …
✅ B. to
👉 They won't go to the National Park.

scenes.question: Choose the correct question.
choices: A. Do you having any sugar?
B. Do you has any sugar?
C. Does you have any sugar?
D. Do you have any sugar?
scenes.hint:
Câu hỏi thì hiện tại đơn: Do + chủ ngữ số nhiều (I/you/we/they) + V nguyên thể?
✅ D. Do you have any sugar?

scenes.question: Find the word with a different sound in the underlined part.
scenes.hint:
Quy tắc -s/-es: đọc /ɪz/ sau âm /s/, /z/, /ʃ/, /ʒ/, /tʃ/, /dʒ/; đọc /s/ sau âm vô thanh (/p/, /k/, /f/, /t/, /θ/); đọc /z/ sau các âm còn lại.
✅ C. gifts
👉 Đuôi -s/-es trong gifts đọc /s/; trong uses, teaches, dishes đọc /ɪz/.

scenes.question: Find the word with a different sound in the underlined part.
scenes.hint:
Quy tắc -s/-es: đọc /ɪz/ sau âm /s/, /z/, /ʃ/, /ʒ/, /tʃ/, /dʒ/; đọc /s/ sau âm vô thanh (/p/, /k/, /f/, /t/, /θ/); đọc /z/ sau các âm còn lại.
✅ B. hates
👉 Đuôi -s/-es trong hates đọc /s/; trong mountains, eggs, sides đọc /z/.

scenes.question: Which word has the same sound as the underlined part of 'gr<u>ea</u>t'?
scenes.hint:
✅ D. steaks
👉 'ea' trong great và steaks đều đọc /eɪ/; trong wears, wear, pears đọc /eə/.

scenes.question: My uncle is ___ police.
scenes.hint:
Dùng 'an' trước từ bắt đầu bằng nguyên âm (a, e, i, o, u); dùng 'a' trước phụ âm. police bắt đầu bằng âm phụ âm → a police.
✅ C. a

scenes.question:
Choose the correct question for the underlined part.
A writer works <u>at home</u>.
choices: A. When does a writer work?
B. How does a writer work?
C. Where does a writer work?
D. What time does a writer work?
scenes.hint:
Đặt câu hỏi cho phần gạch chân.
✅ C. Where does a writer work?
👉 Phần gạch chân 'at home' → hỏi nơi chốn (Where).

scenes.question: How do you say this date: "March 26th"?
scenes.hint:
Đọc ngày bằng số thứ tự: the + số thứ tự + of + tháng. 26th = twenty-sixth.
✅ C. the twenty-sixth of March

scenes.question: How many syllables are there in the word "enough"?
scenes.hint:
Đếm số âm tiết (mỗi âm tiết có đúng một nguyên âm được đọc lên).
✅ B. two → 2 âm tiết (enough)

scenes.question: You can go ___ the club by bicycle.
scenes.hint:
go to + nơi chốn: đi đến …
✅ D. to
👉 You can go to the club by bicycle.
